title: pthread_mutex_init return value ignored
description:
Line 215: pthread_mutex_init(&queue->lock, NULL) discards return value. pthread_mutex_init can fail with EAGAIN (system limit), ENOMEM, or EPERM. On failure, the mutex is in an undefined state and all subsequent lock_queue/unlock_queue calls invoke undefined behavior. Should return -errno on failure.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 215
close_reason: Fixed: pthread_mutex_init now checks return value and returns -err on failure
